column1: # The integration tier's route truth, written by hand from the fixtures, not from a dispatch's
# output: the route and outcome TestTierRoutes expects of every committed fixture input, each
# dispatched through every adapter in the order the test lists them, over one file index, and of
# the found parts that matter. One row per line, tab-separated:
#   input    the input's path under the repository's root
#   place    where the part was found: "-" for the input itself, else each Where from the input's
#            child down to the part, joined by " > "; "*" matches any run of characters
#   name     the part's name; "*" matches any run of characters
#   route    the route the part must have
#   outcome  the outcome the part must come to
# A found part's row matches at least one event, and every event it matches has its route and
# outcome. Content the index already holds is seen: the fixtures share attachments and media,
# and an input dispatched after another holding the same bytes sees them.
# document: the three fixture sets, through gs, each page's text layer and PNG.
# office, OOXML: every document is office's; its pictures are found as stored, a PNG or JPEG
# vision's, and a metafile as its PNG, which office converts with LibreOffice and magick. office's
# generator draws the same two PNGs into drawings.libreoffice.xlsx, media.libreoffice.docx, and
# slide-objects.libreoffice.pptx, their members' SHA-256s beginning 0fcca33b and 10a86bd7: the
# workbook, dispatched first, prepares them, and the other two see them.
# office, legacy: LibreOffice in its pinned image converts each, generated and real.
# office, the TIFF picture: magick converts it, and its PNG is vision's.
# picture: each SVG to its PNG through magick; the script-bearing one's flags are active, which
# email, the generated messages as .eml: moth.png first prepared here; the CSV and the text
# attachment are text, which no stage takes yet.
# email, the same messages as .msg: moth.png is seen; the forwarded message is a file of its own,
# email, the generated store: the same attachments again.
# email, the MIME inputs: an .eml, an mboxrd, and the rlug mbox. mbox.rlug-0 to -4 are its
# messages one a file, each beginning with its header, no "From " line, and named with no .eml
# extension: route takes a bare message as one only by that extension or a stored message type,
# email, the public .msg files: a BMP stored as alfresco.gif is vision's by its signature; an
# embedded message's PDF is the document stage's; Outlook 2003's eleven JPEGs are vision's.
# email, the public stores: libyal's outlook.pst holds Outlook 2003's JPEGs twice, seen; the
# passworded store's password protects nothing mail reads.
# email, the built message, as its .eml source and as the .msg: the docx and the xls are office
# fixtures dispatched above, seen; the TIFF and the EMF as attached are the picture stage's; the
# attached .msg is a copy of generated/msg/03-html-inline-image.msg, dispatched above, seen. The
# .msg's attachments are the source's, byte for byte, all seen.
# onenote, Interop-TestSuites: sections and notebooks; the encrypted section is refused, and
# skipped inside its notebook. A page's embedded picture, Chrysanthemum.jpg, is vision's, and its
# embedded file, testing.docx, office's, seen again through the notebook; onenote's content.json
# onenote, onenote.rs: New Section 1 is dispatched first, its picture and its ink prepared there;
# handwriting_recognition holds the same page, 5eaf76b1, so the same picture, seen, but its ink
# is that page's 62 ink containers, where New Section 1's is one: another SVG, prepared. New
# Section Group's second section holds a page's image container, dummy_1.png, vision's, and an
# embedded MP3, audio, its plan and windows prepared through ffmpeg; its notebook sees both.
# inspect's hazards: a ZIP or a tar with an unsafe entry name, a link, a device, or a declared
# bomb is quarantined; the 8 MiB bombs are under the default size, so the archive stage writes their
# zeros, which no stage takes, bomb.tar.gz's tar first; a gzip stream holding an unsafe tar is
# prepared and the tar quarantined; clean.tar.gz's and unnamed.tgz's tar is clean.tar's bytes,
# dispatched before them, so seen; the encrypted ZIP's readable entry is dispatched and the ZIP is
# encrypted; the other hazards' flags are active, which proceed to their stages.

column2: gzip content bomb.tar > tar entry zeros.bin

column1: # sevenzip's archives, through 7zz: each ZIP entry of a method archive/zip doesn't read (Deflate64,
# implode, xz, LZMA, PPMd, zstd) and bzip2's, which compress/bzip2 reads, is extracted and routed
# by its content and name, a name with no extension unrouted; a 7z's and a cabinet's files are
# found below them. A 7z or cabinet whose listing names a traversing, absolute, or drive letter
# entry, a link, or a FIFO, and a zstd stream whose header declares 4 GiB, is quarantined by the
# stage before anything is extracted; the 8 MiB bombs are under the default size, so their zeros
# are written, which no stage takes. clean.tar.zst holds inspect's clean.tar, and notebook.cab
# onenote.rs's section and notebook, all dispatched before, so seen. encrypted.7z's clear entry is
# dispatched and the 7z is encrypted; encrypted-headers.7z lists nothing, so it is encrypted at once.
# tool: a WAV, audio, its plan and windows prepared through ffmpeg.
